data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for card scanning and OCR of identity documents using BlinkCard SDK.
data.what_it_does: It provides a Flutter wrapper around the native BlinkCard SDK for secure payment card scanning, OCR, and information extraction. It supports both default camera UX scanning and DirectAPI static image scanning.
use_when: You need to scan payment or identity cards in your Flutter application.
You want to extract card details such as cardholder name, card number, and expiry date via camera or static images.
avoid_when: You only need basic barcode scanning (use mobile_scanner instead).
Your target iOS platform is below iOS 16.0.
strengths: Comprehensive card scanning and OCR capabilities.
Supports both default camera UX and static image DirectAPI scanning.
weaknesses: Requires native SDK license key from Microblink Developer Hub.
Strict minimum requirements including iOS 16.0+ and Android compileSdk 36.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling Swift Package Manager support on iOS, setting minimum iOS version to 16.0, configuring Android compileSdk to 36 and Kotlin 2.1+, and providing a valid Microblink license key.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need general barcode and QR code scanning without specialized credit card OCR.
